pageCache.pageTitle: Addison Primary School & Nursery - Values Based Education
pageCache.text:
Values Based Education
Our Approach
Being a values-based school we seek to promote an educational philosophy based on valuing self, others and the environment through, the consideration of an ethical values vocabulary (principles that guide behaviour), as the basis of good educational practice. This approach encourages adults to model values and to give time for reflective practices that empowers individuals to be effective learners and good citizens.
Our values underpin our behaviour. Developing a sense of mutual respect for others, honesty and a willingness to take responsibility for your own actions underpins our approach to behaviour.
There are 5 values at Addison. We focus on one value every half term. Each value has a number of reflection points which enables us to share and understand a common values vocabulary.
Revision of the 5 values
To make these values more accessible to our pupils we have created avatars for each value. We completed a school project to design what each character looks like and the names have been selected by our pupils.

pageCache.pageTitle: Addison Primary School & Nursery - Afterschool Clubs
pageCache.text:
Afterschool Clubs
After-school clubs provide pupils with an excellent opportunity to explore their interests, develop new skills, and connect with peers in a fun and engaging environment. These clubs offer a variety of activities, ranging from academic creative arts to sports. By participating, pupils can discover their passions, build confidence, and enhance their teamwork and problem-solving abilities.
After-school clubs also create a supportive space for socialising and learning outside the traditional classroom, fostering a sense of belonging and accomplishment.
Why Join an After-School Club?
Discover Your Passion: Explore hobbies or interests in a fun and supportive environment
Build Skills: Develop valuable life skills like teamwork, problem-solving and creativity.
Socialise: Make new friends and connect with peers who share your interests.
Enrich Your Learning: Extend classroom lessons with hands-on activities.
Have Fun: Enjoy spending time doing what you love while learning and growing

pageCache.pageTitle: Addison Primary School & Nursery - Parents Evening Booking
pageCache.text:
Parents Evening Booking
Your Account Details
We will initially generate an account for you using the email address you have provided to the school for communications. When we do this, you will receive an email inviting you to create a password for your account.
If you have not received the message, check your junk/spam folder and ensure that you have added the junipereducation.org domain to your safe senders list
Logging in
You can access our booking system at any time using this link:
You will be prompted to log in by entering your email address and password. If you have not yet set your password, you can request a password reset email by clicking ‘Forgot your password’. You should use the email address you have registered with the school.
Making a Booking
The child you are booking for will show in the top right-hand corner of the screen. If you have more than one child at our school, you will see a circle for each child. Simply click on the relevant circle to select the child you want to make a booking for.
Find the teacher and time you’d like to book and click to reserve the time slot. The selection will show in green with the word “RESERVED”. The time allocated for each slot will be automatically populated.
Please note: the slot will only be reserved for 10 minutes.
To confirm the reservation you’ll need to click on the save button in the bottom right corner.
Parents Evening Booking

pageCache.pageTitle: Addison Primary School & Nursery - About Us
pageCache.text:
About Us
Welcome to Addison Primary School
Addison is an outstanding primary school (Ofsted, March 2025) that provides a nurturing and stimulating environment where every child is encouraged to reach their full potential. We provide high-quality teaching, innovative curriculum delivery, and a strong focus on both academic achievement (we are significantly above national scores in all assessments) and personal development.
Our core set of values are: Respect, Responsibility, Perseverance, Honesty and Friendship. Values are principles that guide behaviour and choices. The Values that we teach are relatable to our pupils through the ‘values characters’. We have a vision where we work together,
‘To give pupils experiences and opportunities that are above and beyond the academic which will enable them to become resilient, compassionate and resourceful individuals’.
Our curriculum is based on a themed approach and every lesson and every experience is tailored towards ensuring that every pupil succeeds. Curriculum themes are used to help all pupils succeed in achieving their goals.
Strong partnerships with parents are part of our success, and the many themed days, for example, International Days, World Book Day, other events are what makes Addison special. Parents and the wider community are actively involved, enhancing student learning and well-being. Please do spend time looking through our website which will guide you through our curriculum intent, approach, vision and values.
Our School

Learning

SEND
Addison Primary School works inclusively with our families to maximize the learning potential of all children in our community. Pupils with SEND are valued members of our school community and every effort is made to support their individual needs.
The SEND co-ordinators are Damien Mc Garrigle and Teresa Hickey.
At Addison we believe that all children have an equal right to a full and rounded education which should enable them to achieve their full potential. We use our best endeavours to secure special educational provision for pupils for who this is required, that is ‘additional to and different from’ that provided within the differentiated curriculum to better respond to the four areas of SEND need below:
We pride ourselves on our welcoming atmosphere and open door policy as well as strong home school links. We hope that you feel able to come and ask any questions you have regarding support for your child.
Find outlined in our SEND documentation further information regarding how we, as a school, provide this support and how you can access advice and support for your child. Please see below the School Offer which provides answers to frequently asked questions and the Local Offer, providing information about the support provided by the local authority.

Parent Handbook 2026-2027
Each year we provide a parent handbook which provides a 'one-stop-shop' for all the information parents/carers may need. We hope you find it useful.
We always welcome feedback and are happy to make changes if you feel there is any other information that you would like to see included.
Parent Handbooks can be downloaded or collected from the main office.
